info.description: One uploaded slip for an order and what Slip2Go answered. Saved before the provider is called. The slip file itself is stored privately (open it with Slip link).

attemptKey.description: orderDocumentId:idempotencyKey — the same upload is processed once.

fileHash.description: SHA-256 of the image — an early repeat signal only, never transaction identity.

storageKey.description: Private file name (deleted after the retention period).

slipLink.description: Signed link to view the slip (staff only).

sanitizedResult.description: Bank-side facts we keep: transRef, sender bank, amount, time, masked receiver. No names.
